title: Breakfast Entitlement Grid by Ashbury Brand (Guest Folios and Ashbury Rewards)
content:
Breakfast on a Guest Folio is governed by five brand figures: whether breakfast is included for every registered guest at no charge, the lowest Ashbury Rewards tier entitled to the elite breakfast benefit, the brand's elite breakfast credit per person per morning at the breakfast outlet, the brand's persons covered by the elite breakfast benefit per morning (the member and registered guests), and whether unused breakfast credit is paid out or carried to other charges.

## Grid

| Brand | Breakfast included for every guest | Lowest tier entitled to the elite breakfast benefit | Elite breakfast credit per person per morning | Persons covered per morning | Unused breakfast credit paid out or carried to other charges |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | Yes | Ashbury Rewards Member | $0.00 | 0 | No |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | Yes | Ashbury Rewards Member | $0.00 | 0 | No |
| Ashbury Hotel | No | Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | $18.00 | 2 | No |
| Ashbury Grand | No | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | $30.00 | 2 | No |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | No | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | $35.00 | 2 | No |
| Ashbury Reserve | No | Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | $45.00 | 2 | No |

## Reading the grid

- At Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites breakfast is complimentary for all registered guests, so the lowest tier shown is Ashbury Rewards Member and the credit and persons figures are $0.00 and 0: there is no separate elite credit at those brands.
- At the other four brands breakfast is charged at the outlet, and the elite breakfast benefit begins at the tier shown "or higher". The Ashbury Rewards tiers in ascending order are Member, Silver Elite, Gold Elite, Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite and Ambassador Elite.

## Entitlement by tier (derived from the grid)

| Member's tier | Ashbury Hotel | Ashbury Grand | Ashbury Resort & Spa | Ashbury Reserve |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | Not entitled | Not entitled | Not entitled | Not entitled |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | Entitled | Not entitled | Not entitled | Not entitled |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled | Entitled |
